storage.notes: Two microSD/microSDHC/microSDXC slots, Class V10 or better recommended; max tested capacity 1.5TB per card

features: AI-powered video analytics: object classification (person, vehicle sub-types), loitering, line crossing, area events, tamper detection, crowd size/growth analytics, unusual activity detection
Teach by Example analytics (with Avigilon Control Center 7.2+ or Unity Video 8.0+)
Built-in audio analytics: glass break, car alarm, smoke alarm, dog bark, tire screech, loud noise, scream, ultrasonic panic alarm (gunshot detection requires separate CAM-AA-GUNSHOT2 license)
HDSM SmartCodec bandwidth management with idle scene mode
3D Noise Reduction Filter, adjustable digital defog
Two heads in one housing - single VMS license and cable for dual coverage
Adjustable mount: 180 deg pan, 360 deg azimuth, 10-95 deg tilt
Onboard FIPS 140-2 L3 certified TPM, Secure Boot, signed/encrypted firmware, CC EAL6+
Privacy zones (up to 64), classified object + pixel motion detection
